newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Bomb kills man in Moscow lift.
newsitem.headline: Bomb kills man in Moscow lift.

text.p: A man was killed and a woman badly wounded when a bomb went off in the lift of a Moscow apartment block in the early hours of Friday, police said.
A spokesman said they were still identifying the man and seeking the cause of the blast, which was equivalent to 800 grams (2 lb) of high explosive.

A Reuters Television cameraman said the lift was destroyed and covered in blood. The hallways on the first three floors of the building were damaged by the blast. Neighbours said they had no idea why their building might be bombed.
The Russian capital has suffered a number of unexplained bomb attacks in recent months.
Four people died on a metro train in June, days before the first round of the presidential election. More than 30 people were hurt in two blasts on crowded trolleybuses in July.
Three passers-by were injured last Sunday when a small car bomb went off outside a shopping centre.
